claim: Decide the archive shelf (Q7 of the seed-lifecycle deliberation): where graduated proto-belief documents and archived plans/ shelves physically live. The operator's invisibility requirement is attached - archived architecture must not sit in the working hierarchy confusing new agents - which rules out archive-in-place. Options on the table: a beliefs/archive/ sibling outside nursery/ proper (the current lean), graduating graph-subject documents alongside the existing plans/ shelves, or nursery/archive/ excluded from working views. Work gated on this decision must dep on its resolution when it mints: the seed-lifecycle graduation prescription, and proto-belief-rename spike item 4 (triage of still-live plans into proto-belief documents; physical archiving of the closed plans/ shelves with a cb.repoint pass).

evidence.detail: Minted so the desk tracks the open decision. The mints-after-Q7 gate existed only as prose - in seed-lifecycle's resolution block, proto-belief-rename spike item 4, the authoring-pipeline routing ledger, and the nursery index - and pre-mint rows carry no machine-readable deps, so nothing structural prevented minting the gated work early. The gate becomes structural at mint time: item 4's and the graduation prescription's future nodes dep on this node's resolution.

todos.action: Archive shelf decided: graduated proto-belief documents live in beliefs/archive/, a sibling outside the nursery bundle (okf.manifest scans nursery/ only, so archived docs leave the live read surface). First graduation: end-skill-redesign.md.
